messages:
Alex R: Quick status check — Vanguard sealed-deploy scheduled tomorrow 09:00 PT. Need final network cert rotation + image signing to be green. Who's taking ownership of those last two items?
Mira C: I can own image signing tonight. Will run the signing pipeline and push to the signed-images bucket. Need the image hash list from you.
Alex R: Attaching list in a sec. @Devon P can you confirm cert rotation for the customer VPC (vanguard)? Any blockers?
Devon P: Cert rotation work is ready on our side, but it's blocked on firewall ACLs from Sec/Net. I pinged @Sanjay K earlier for approvals.
Sanjay K: Security approved the ephemeral port set (:white_check_mark:). Net-team still needs precise egress IPs for the air-gapped proxy and a NAT mapping. @Shera (net-team) can you take this?
Shera (net-team): Net-team here — we need the exact egress IP list (and confirmation this is the same as `staging-proxy-v1`). Also need to know whether customer NAT ips are static.
Mira C: Image list (short): `sha256:abcd1234...` and `sha256:ef012345...`. I'll start signing in staging path `signed-images/vanguard/` and report back.
InfraBot: deploy-bot: canary image upload succeeded: `signed-images/vanguard/sha256-abcd1234...` -> 2024-07-14T02:15Z
Alex R: If net-team can push ACLs before 07:00 PT we can run smoke tests at 07:30. Who's oncall for canary run?
QA-Leo: I'll run the smoke tests at 07:30 PT and capture logs to the deployment runbook. I need SSH creds for the vpc jumpbox and the test account.
Devon P: Oncall for the weekend is Marta. @Marta can you be reachable ~06:30 PT for the final handshake and to approve the cert swap?
Marta: Yep, I'll be online 06:30 PT. Quick heads-up: the air-gap installer sometimes fails checksum verification — plan to allow a rerun (adds ~12m).
Alex R: Noted. Also code-review ping: PR #1234 (canary fallback policy tweak) needs a quick signoff from eng-runtime before we flip the canary flag.
Sanjay K: I'll review PR #1234 after I finish the firewall approval.
Shera (net-team): Net-team will provision NAT by 06:45 PT and push ACLs by 06:55 PT. Confirming egress IPs now; will paste below once I have them from the infra subnet owner.
Alex R: Checklist snapshot: image signing (Mira) — in progress; cert rotation (Devon) — blocked on ACLs; NAT/ACL (Shera) — provisioning by 06:55; smoke tests (QA-Leo) — scheduled 07:30; oncall Marta — available. Fallback = spin up temporary hosted routing if anything slips. Please add any last-minute blockers by EOD.
Devon P: One more external dep: customer needs to sign the maintenance window. PM had tentative OK but final sign required.
Alex R: @Tess (PM) can you confirm customer approval?
Tess (PM): Confirmed — Vanguard approved maintenance window 08:00-09:00 PT. They requested a 30m heads-up before start.
Alex R: Copy. I'll schedule the 30m notification for 07:30 PT. Thanks all. /cc @InfraBot
InfraBot: reminder-bot: 30m notice scheduled -> will send at 07:30 PT.
